name: One Last Pint
source:
Hey, you. You're- wait... wrong game. I'm sorry but you're not actually awake, you're dead. Welcome to the Afterlife!

One Last Pint is a short Visual Novel inspired by the Egyptian Afterlife.  Meet Anpu, discuss your life, and learn your fate.

[From [url=https://badeviant.itch.io/one-last-pint]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
嘿，你。你——等等……玩错游戏了。抱歉，你并没有真正醒来，你已经死了。欢迎来到来世！

最后一品脱是一部受埃及来世启发的短篇视觉小说。遇见安普，探讨人生，了解命运。

[来自[url=https://badeviant.itch.io/one-last-pint]Itch.io[/url]]
